Fresh seafood, local dishes and unique dining experience at a GREAT price!
Feb 2024 • Family
I had a wonderful time at this all-you-can eat seafood buffet! The variety of seafood and local dishes were quite impressive. I was able to try different traditional Vietnamese dishes including Banh Cuon Hai San which was prepared in front of me. It was described as a "seafood stuffed pancake" but it was actually delicate bite-sized crepes stuffed with a tasty filling. There were several other stations making local dishes including grilled oysters, grilled meat and so many others which were all amazing. The variety of local desserts were also impressive and so wonderfully displayed. At a cost of VND 560,000 or US$24, it was well worth the price for this unique dining experience.
Insider tip:
This restaurant gets really busy especially on the weekends so reservations via phone or email are highly recommended!

Our first night in Ha Long Bay
Nov 2019 • Couples
Booked into the Wyndham hotel by a friend who advised trying this restaurant just 5 minutes walk away. Was 560,000 dong for the all you can eat buffet (about $24 US). Fantastic range of lovely food including a lot of seafood. Many chef stations round the room cooking to order. One was doing a lovely fish soup with prawns, squid and crab. Particularly enjoyed the fried crocodile, a real first. Going back tonight so can sample the remainder of the vast menu. Oh yes, plenty of soups and desserts.

Beautiful seaside view, reasonable price, friendly welcome!
Aug 2019
In my opinion, Oriental Lotus should be one of the good choice for lunch in Bai Chay, Ha Long
I- Strong points:
1- Location: In the center of Bai Chay, you can easily find this restaurant if you walk by this place
-View: What a beautiful seaside view! Just sitting beside the windows listenning to the sound of the sea wi
2- Price: just 250k VND/pax ( just 11$), what a reasonable price ! Cheap in comparison with other restaurants in Bai Chay.
3- Food quality : not so much but enough, they serve sashimi , oyster, octopus,beef and lobster...
4- Service: Friendly and cosy
II. Weak points:
But I don't like the way the manager arrange table , it made us feel the space become crowded and uncomfatable -we can not stand up to pick up some food without disturbing the nearby customer. 
This time we are a team, a company so it doesn't get into a real matter but the next time I'm not sure.
Secondly,small thing but I dislike it : We have to pay immediately for every time I order the drinks, Why don't they charge into the bill and let us pay later.

Pretty good buffet at great price
Jan 2018 • Family
We were pleasantly surprised, and ended up having an enjoyable evening at a great price.

We were almost the only international diners there, reflecting the fact it is little known and little publicised on western review sites.

We shouldn't have been apprehensive, as it is professionally managed, in a Seaview setting with great selections. Drinks are fairly priced and affordable.

Mostly seafood, including prawns, oysters, mussels and others, along with grilled meats, some sushi, salads, and dessert. 

On our evening there was also live, traditional music.

At 280VD great value
